description: Open the files an agent builds or exports with one click, instead of copying a path out of its reply. Each file or folder the agent hands over shows as a card with an icon, its name, format and size. A click on a file opens bb's preview, and Open in reveals it in Finder or opens it in its default app. A bundled skill tells agents when to hand over files this way. Finder and the default app open on the Mac running the bb server; no account or external service.
